# DeepFilterNet3 (weights and licences)

No upstream source is vendored. The network is ported to C++ in `Source/Engines/dfn/`; this folder holds only:

- `models/dfn3_standard.bin`: the DeepFilterNet3 weights as one blob (8,539,604 bytes, 66 tensors, little-endian float32, SHA-256 `c2d1567a952a97f7fbb227a92f004ca7111baef0b478c54c7dd23ec7564c9fae`). Generated by `Tools/DfnBlobTool/dfn_blob_tool.py blob` from the official ONNX export; embedded into the plugin as BinaryData.
- `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`: verbatim from upstream.

## Source

- Upstream: https://github.com/Rikorose/DeepFilterNet, commit `d375b2d`.
- Model tarball: `models/DeepFilterNet3_onnx.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `c94d91f70911001c946e0fabb4aa9adc37045f45a03b56008cb0c8244cb63616`.
- Paper: H. Schröter et al., "DeepFilterNet: Perceptually Motivated Real-Time Speech Enhancement", arXiv:2305.08227.

## Licence

The code is MIT OR Apache-2.0; this project uses the C++ port under the MIT licence. The weights have no separate licence file. They are redistributed under the same MIT OR Apache-2.0 terms, on this basis:

- The upstream root `LICENSE` (vendored here) licenses the repository under MIT OR Apache-2.0 without limiting it to code.
- Upstream itself ships this exact model inside its MIT/Apache-2.0 `libDF` crate: `libDF/src/tract.rs` embeds `models/DeepFilterNet3_onnx.tar.gz` with `include_bytes!`, and `libDF/Cargo.toml` declares `license = "MIT/Apache-2.0"` (commit `d375b2d`).
- The authors' paper states "the framework as well as pretrained weights have been published under an open source license".

Upstream issues #697 and #700 ask for an explicit statement on the weights and were unanswered as of 2026-10-18.
